title: SiGMA Awards 2025: A Night to Remember
excerpt: A short recap of the moments that shaped our nominations night at the SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025 — the people, the conversations, and the next steps.
introHtml:
This is a short recap of the night that earned us two nominations at the SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025. It is less about the trophies and more about the people, the conversations in the corridors, and the energy that comes back to the office on Monday morning.

If you missed the live coverage, this is the version we tell partners over coffee.

sections.title: How the Evening Played Out
sections.bodyHtml:
The ceremony itself was tight and well-paced, with clear category framing and a strong line-up of finalists. The most valuable part for our team, however, happened around the room — quick chats with operators, advertisers, and other networks comparing notes on the year.

Two themes kept coming back across those conversations: long-term partner programs are quietly outperforming short-term campaigns, and teams with strong internal culture are easier to spot from the outside than people think.

subsections.title: Moments worth remembering from the evening:
subsections.bodyHtml:
• Genuine reactions when both nominations were announced
  • A few candid conversations with industry veterans
  • Spontaneous photos with partners we usually only see in calls
  • A clear, shared sense that the bar is moving up across the board

sections.title: What This Means for the Year Ahead
sections.bodyHtml:
Recognition is great fuel, but it doesn't change the roadmap — it sharpens it. Our priorities for the year remain the same: cleaner partner onboarding, better reporting, and a smoother day-to-day for affiliates working with our brands.

To follow what we ship next, the easiest place is affiliate.makeberry.com.
